packageRules.description: One weekly pull request, so one rebuild, automerged once the smoke test passes on both architectures
Pin the Postgres base by its multi-arch index digest
Keep Postgres minors coming while a major waits, since without this Renovate offers only the newest release
A new Postgres major needs the Dockerfile's pg18 names changed by hand, so it gets its own pull request and never automerges
The runner images are a choice, not a dependency, and the matrix labels are out of Renovate's reach, so it would move only some of them
